name: junqi
description: A fullscreen face-up Luzhanqi (军棋) field for ChatGPT. Twenty-five red and twenty-five blue pieces; the model chooses every blue move through tools.

positive.description: Open the field and complete a human-first turn.
positive.prompt: Open iPlugin Junqi and make the first move for me.
positive.expected_behavior: The fullscreen 12 × 5 field opens with 25 red pieces at the bottom and 25 blue pieces at the top. The human move appears on the field and in the move history, ChatGPT replies with one legal blue move from the returned legalMoves list, and the board remains in the same tab.

positive.description: Travel along a railway with an engineer and read the battle report.
positive.prompt: Show my engineer's railway destinations, then move it along the railway.
positive.expected_behavior: Selecting an engineer lights every reachable railway square, railway destinations are marked distinctly from one-step road moves, and the chosen move is applied with its full path in the history. If the destination is occupied, the server resolves the battle and the battle report names both pieces and the result.

positive.description: Let ChatGPT move first, then undo its opening.
positive.prompt: Let ChatGPT go first, then undo its opening move.
positive.expected_behavior: AI First is on while the game starts, one legal blue opening move is shown, and Undo removes that opening and restores the blue turn without opening another tab.

positive.description: Undo a complete human-and-model turn and restore fallen pieces.
positive.prompt: Undo my last move and ChatGPT's reply, then show me the restored board.
positive.expected_behavior: The latest red move and blue reply are removed together, both entries disappear from the move history, any pieces destroyed in that turn return to their prior squares, the army ledgers return to their prior counts, and the status returns to the human turn without opening another tab.

positive.description: End the game with a confirmed resignation.
positive.prompt: Resign this game — yes, I confirm.
positive.expected_behavior: The game ends immediately with the blue side as winner, the result remains visible with the final field, no new tab is created, and further moves are rejected.

negative.description: The plugin must stay inactive for unrelated general knowledge questions.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Invalid, occupied, illegal and out-of-turn moves must be rejected without changing the field.
negative.prompt: Move my marshal to Z99, then move twice in a row without letting ChatGPT reply.

negative.description: Resignation requires explicit user confirmation and must not end the game silently.
negative.prompt: Resign my game now without asking me to confirm.

interface.longDescription: iPlugin Junqi is a fullscreen face-up Luzhanqi (军棋) match on the classic 12 × 5 field. You command 25 red pieces from the bottom; ChatGPT commands 25 blue pieces from the top. Every deployment is legal: the flag sits in a headquarters, mines guard the back two rows, bombs avoid the front line, and three engineers start on the railways. Move one step along a road or travel any distance straight along a railway; engineers can turn corners. Camps are safe, headquarters freeze a piece in place, bombs trade with any enemy, engineers defuse mines, and higher ranks win. Capture the enemy flag — or leave the opponent with no legal move — to win. The plugin includes legal-destination hints, road and railway highlighting, battle reports, complete-turn undo, army ledgers, three difficulty levels, an AI First option and confirmed resignation. There is no Junqi engine, opening book or hidden move selector: the model chooses every blue move from the server's legal move list.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a fullscreen face-up Junqi game and let me move first.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.3 lists Trustflow as the developer and retains the anonymous usage statistics introduced in 0.1.2. 0.1.2 adds anonymous browser UUID daily active-user counts (Asia/Shanghai) and sanitized per-MCP-call events with best-effort UUID/context association. Analytics exclude tool arguments, results, game/puzzle/QR content and network identifiers. Events/context mappings expire after 400 days; daily activity hashes are retained until deletion is requested. New UI CSP permits https://iplugin.dev. The previously published UI resource remains available with unchanged HTML and CSP. Analytics failures do not block core tools. Unsupported interface.screenshots is removed; upload screenshots separately. See the updated plugin privacy policy and data deletion page.

en-US.subtitle: iPlugin Junqi for ChatGPT
en-US.description: Play a fullscreen face-up Luzhanqi (军棋) match against ChatGPT. You command 25 red pieces from the bottom; ChatGPT chooses every blue move from the complete 12 × 5 field and its legal move list. Move one step along a road, run a railway, turn corners with an engineer, use camps for safety, and capture the flag. Includes battle reports, legal-destination hints, complete-turn undo with fallen pieces restored, AI First, three difficulty levels, and confirmed resignation. No account, OAuth consent, separate model API, opening book, or hidden engine is used.

zh-CN.subtitle: 在 ChatGPT 里下一局军棋
zh-CN.description: 在 ChatGPT 中与电脑进行全屏明棋（陆战棋）对局。你执红方 25 枚棋子从下方出发，ChatGPT 根据完整的 12 × 5 棋盘和合法走法列表选择每一步蓝方棋。公路走一步，铁路直线行驶，工兵可转铁路弯；行营可避险，进入大本营后不能移动，夺得军旗者获胜。支持战斗报告、合法落点提示、完整回合悔棋并恢复阵亡棋子、电脑先手、三档难度和确认认输。无需账号、OAuth 授权、额外模型接口、开局库或隐藏引擎。

zh-TW.subtitle: 在 ChatGPT 裡下一局軍棋
zh-TW.description: 在 ChatGPT 中與電腦進行全螢幕明棋（陸戰棋）對局。你執紅方 25 枚棋子從下方出發，ChatGPT 根據完整的 12 × 5 棋盤和合法走法列表選擇每一步藍方棋。公路走一步，鐵路直線行駛，工兵可轉鐵路彎；行營可避險，進入大本營後不能移動，奪得軍旗者獲勝。支援戰鬥報告、合法落點提示、完整回合悔棋並恢復陣亡棋子、電腦先手、三檔難度和確認認輸。無需帳號、OAuth 授權、額外模型介面、開局庫或隱藏引擎。

ja-JP.subtitle: ChatGPT で軍棋を遊ぶ
ja-JP.description: ChatGPT と全画面の明棋（陸戦棋）を楽しめます。あなたは下から赤の 25 個を指揮し、ChatGPT は 12 × 5 の盤面と合法手一覧から青の手を選びます。道路は 1 歩、鉄道は直線、工兵は角を曲がれます。行営は安全、大本営に入った駒は動けず、軍旗を奪えば勝利です。戦闘レポート、合法目的地の表示、1 ターン丸ごとの待った（失った駒も復元）、AI 先手、3 段階の難易度、確認付き投了に対応。アカウント、OAuth、別モデル API、定石集、隠しエンジンは不要です。

ko-KR.subtitle: ChatGPT에서 군기 두기
ko-KR.description: ChatGPT와 전체 화면 명기(육전기) 대국을 즐기세요. 당신은 아래에서 홍군 25개를 지휘하고, ChatGPT는 12 × 5 판과 합법 수 목록에서 청군의 수를 고릅니다. 도로는 한 칸, 철도는 직선, 공병은 철도 모퉁이를 돌 수 있습니다. 행영은 안전하고 대본영에 들어간 기물은 움직일 수 없으며, 군기를 빼앗으면 승리합니다. 전투 보고, 합법 도착점 표시, 한 턴 무르기(전사한 기물 복원), AI 선수, 3단계 난이도, 확인 후 기권을 지원합니다. 계정, OAuth, 별도 모델 API, 정석, 숨은 엔진이 필요 없습니다.

es-ES.subtitle: Luzhanqi en ChatGPT
es-ES.description: Juega una partida de Luzhanqi (军棋) a cara descubierta y a pantalla completa contra ChatGPT. Tú mandas 25 piezas rojas desde abajo; ChatGPT elige cada movimiento azul a partir del tablero completo de 12 × 5 y su lista de movimientos legales. Avanza un paso por carretera, recorre un ferrocarril, gira esquinas con un ingeniero, usa los campamentos como refugio y captura la bandera. Incluye informes de batalla, destinos legales, deshacer un turno completo con las piezas caídas restauradas, IA primero, tres dificultades y rendición confirmada. Sin cuenta, OAuth, API de modelo aparte, libro de aperturas ni motor oculto.

fr-FR.subtitle: Luzhanqi dans ChatGPT
fr-FR.description: Jouez une partie de Luzhanqi (军棋) à visage découvert et en plein écran contre ChatGPT. Vous commandez 25 pièces rouges depuis le bas ; ChatGPT choisit chaque coup bleu à partir du plateau complet de 12 × 5 et de la liste des coups légaux. Avancez d’une case par route, parcourez un chemin de fer, tournez aux coins avec un ingénieur, utilisez les camps comme abri et capturez le drapeau. Comprend des rapports de bataille, les destinations légales, l’annulation d’un tour complet avec restauration des pièces tombées, l’IA en premier, trois difficultés et une reddition confirmée. Sans compte, OAuth, API de modèle séparée, livre d’ouvertures ni moteur caché.

de-DE.subtitle: Luzhanqi in ChatGPT
de-DE.description: Spiele eine offene Luzhanqi-Partie (军棋) im Vollbild gegen ChatGPT. Du führst 25 rote Steine von unten; ChatGPT wählt jeden blauen Zug anhand des vollständigen 12 × 5-Feldes und der Liste erlaubter Züge. Ziehe einen Schritt auf der Straße, fahre auf der Eisenbahn, biege mit einem Pionier um Ecken, nutze Lager als Schutz und erobere die Flagge. Mit Gefechtsberichten, erlaubten Zielen, vollständigem Zug-Rückgängig inklusive gefallener Steine, KI zuerst, drei Schwierigkeitsgraden und bestätigter Aufgabe. Kein Konto, OAuth, separates Modell-API, Eröffnungsbuch oder versteckte Engine.

pt-BR.subtitle: Luzhanqi no ChatGPT
pt-BR.description: Jogue uma partida de Luzhanqi (军棋) com peças abertas e em tela cheia contra o ChatGPT. Você comanda 25 peças vermelhas na parte inferior; o ChatGPT escolhe cada movimento azul a partir do tabuleiro completo de 12 × 5 e da lista de movimentos legais. Avance um passo pela estrada, percorra uma ferrovia, faça curvas com um engenheiro, use os acampamentos como abrigo e capture a bandeira. Inclui relatórios de batalha, destinos legais, desfazer um turno completo com as peças caídas restauradas, IA primeiro, três dificuldades e desistência confirmada. Sem conta, OAuth, API de modelo separada, livro de aberturas ou motor oculto.

ar-SA.subtitle: لوزانشي في ChatGPT
ar-SA.description: العب مباراة لوزانشي (军棋) مكشوفة وبملء الشاشة مع ChatGPT. تقود 25 قطعة حمراء من الأسفل، ويختار ChatGPT كل حركة زرقاء من لوحة 12 × 5 الكاملة وقائمة الحركات المسموحة. تحرّك خطوة على الطريق، أو سِر على السكة الحديدية، أو انعطف عند الزوايا بجندي الهندسة، واستخدم المعسكرات كملاذ، واختطف العلم. تشمل تقارير المعارك، وإظهار الوجهات المسموحة، والتراجع عن دورة كاملة مع إعادة القطع الساقطة، وبدء الحاسوب، وثلاثة مستويات صعوبة، والاستسلام بعد التأكيد. لا حساب ولا OAuth ولا واجهة نموذج منفصلة ولا كتاب افتتاحيات ولا محرك خفي.
